verdict.rationale: Medusa publishes machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Store and Admin REST APIs (medusa-gh-x1) and documents Order and Fulfillment modules (medusa-docs-23, medusa-docs-26). Webhook Events appear as a Cloud feature (medusa-docs-16), and a community user notes built-in swap/return handling (medusa-comm-10), so the building blocks for agent-driven post-purchase handling exist. However, most evidence is page titles or feature bullets rather than end-to-end lifecycle documentation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of order status transitions, fulfillment, and return endpoints for headless/agent use; webhook event coverage for order lifecycle events beyond a pricing-page bullet; and hands-on corroboration of a no-admin automated flow.
